title: Full English simulation
summary: Execute the complete reported English profile under controlled timing and review the evidence safely.

provenance.authored_by: Codex English V3-B Sprint breadth milestone

sections.title: State the simulation rules
content: Write the separate 90-minute and 30-minute clocks, no-help conditions, stop rules and interruption protocol before starting.

sections.title: Protect the complete blueprint
content: Reserve time for both reading passages and a checking buffer. Use adjustable budgets for earlier tasks while exact counts remain unconfirmed.

sections.title: Recover from uncertainty
content: Commit the best supported response, flag it and move. Resume a saved session after a genuine technical interruption without discussing items.

sections.title: Rehearse decision points
content: Practise transitions between tasks, the reading reserve, the composition start and the final checking stop.

sections.title: Prepare one traceable run
content: Use one quiet session and one immutable attempt. Record disruptions but do not add external help.

sections.title: Turn results into action
content: Analyse strand results and error causes. Do not treat the total as an admission prediction or repeat exposed answers as proof of growth.

sections.title: Check simulation readiness
content: This five-decision readiness check is not the protected full mock.
